svg.aria-label: The ASCII table: 128 codes arranged by their two hex digits
svg.text: control codes we’ve already met in spirit: STX/ETX (~S/~E), ACK/NAK (~A/~N), LF/CR (~L), ESC (~)

figure.figcaption: ASCII. “A” is 41, “a” is 61, “0” is 30. Every character your keyboard can type is somewhere in here.
